1.title: Jump Pack
1.description:
Affects casting unit

+2 Movement
-20% Ranged Accuracy
Ignores movement penalties from terrain
Expires in 1 Turn
Will not provoke pistol reactions when charging

2.title: Tactical Precision
2.description:
Affects single target ally within 2 tiles

+20% Melee Accuracy
+20% Ranged Accuracy
+1 Armor Piercing
Expires in 1 Turn

3.title: Graces of the Angel
3.description:
Affects all allies within a range of 2 tiles

+50% Momentum Gains
Expires in 2 Turns

4.title: Sword of Sanguinius
4.description:
Affects casting unit

+50% Damage
+2 Movement
-15 Evasion
Expires in 1 Turn

7.title: Heal Thy Brother
7.description: Heals a single non-vehicle ally within 1 tile for 35 HP.

+25% Melee Damage
Expires in 2 Turns

10.title: Embrace the Blood
10.description:
Energies the Red Thirst of a single friendly unit within 2 tiles.

+40 Momentum
Expires in 2 Turns

16.title: Omnissiah's Touch
16.description: Heals a single mechanical ally within 1 tile for 75 HP.

+1 Melee Armor

Expires in 2 Turns

-1 MP when leaving tile
-10 Evasion
Expires in 2 Turns

22.description:
Affects casting unit

+2 Movement
+5% Evasion
Expires in 1 Turn

23.title: Volatile
23.description: Explodes on death, dealing 52-70 damage at 3 armour piercing to units within 1 tile.

+2 Movement
+20 Evasion

30.title: Vision of Angelic Fury
30.description: Summon a vision of Sanguinius that terrifies all enemies who see it. Does 20 Momentum damage to all enemy units within 2 tiles, and 18-25 Psychic damage to all enemy units within 1 tile.

31.title: Blood Lance
31.description: Throws a lance that damages enemy units along the path to the target (maximum range: 2). Deals 37-50 splash damage with 4 armor piercing to up to 6 targets per tile.
